scope: Embryonic dorsal epidermal intercalation, ventral enclosure, and adjacent neuroblast/rosette processes. Existing early-embryo packing and post-enclosure elongation models distinguished from a dynamic enclosure model.
queries: C. elegans ventral enclosure mathematical model simulation
C. elegans dorsal intercalation computational model
C. elegans epidermal Potts phase-field vertex
ventral enclosure finite element mechanical model
convergent extension crawling junction contraction integration
conclusion: Direct worm studies examined here primarily constrain polarity, protrusions, adhesion and multi-tissue coupling; the expanded note compares mechanistic simulations developed in other systems without relabeling them as validated worm simulations. This search is not a proof of absence.
